_bootloader-cleanup.doc: cannot be run before a successful reboot has actually happened.

_cache-push.doc: once (see `just service enable attic`'s setup guidance). Usage: just cache push [cache]

_feature-disable.doc: Use 'just feature disable all' to disable every feature.

_feature-enable.doc: Use 'just feature enable all' to enable every feature.

_feature-list.doc: List all optional features and their enabled/disabled status.

_kernel-cache-guard.doc: and lets the rebuild proceed normally.

_kernel-status.doc: and which version is currently pinned and served.

_kill-switch-off.doc: Turn the kill switch off. On stateless this asks for your password and lasts until reboot.

_kill-switch-on.doc: Turn the kill switch on — blocks all internet traffic outside the PIA tunnel.

_menu.doc: Runs the hidden recipe _<group>-<key>, so `just vpn up` == `just _vpn-up`.

_pick-target.doc: caller can capture the answer with $(...).

_plex-pass-enable.doc: Usage: just plex-pass enable   /   just plex-pass disable

_remote-storage-list.doc: mountpoint, live mount status and write group. Read-only — never mounts anything.

_require-ai.doc: Guard: the AI assistant recipes need the ai feature (vexos-ai on PATH).

_require-desktop-role.doc: supported there — neither role wires /etc/nixos/features.nix into its module set).

_require-known-service.doc: Guard: abort unless `service` is one of _server_service_names.

_require-nixos.doc: Guard: build/switch recipes need nix and sudo on a Linux (NixOS) host.

_require-server-role.doc: Guard: abort if the current host is not running a server variant.

_run-storage-script.doc: multi-word argument reaches the script intact rather than being re-split.

_service-available.doc: List all available server service modules (catalog view, no role required).

_service-disable.doc: Disable a server service module.  Usage: just service disable docker

_service-enable.doc: Enable a server service module.  Usage: just service enable docker

_service-info.doc: just service info jellyfin   — specific service

_service-list.doc: List enabled server services and how to access them.

_service-restart.doc: start-limit-hit failure first. Usage: just service restart joplin

_service-units.doc: Prints space-separated unit names (without .service) to stdout.

_vpn-down.doc: Disconnect the PIA VPN (with the kill switch on, this leaves you offline).

_vpn-login.doc: Store PIA credentials (root-only file; prompts, never echoed). Run once.

_vpn-protocol.doc: Switch protocol: wireguard (default) or openvpn (backup). Reconnects if connected.

_vpn-region.doc: Choose a PIA region, or "auto" for the fastest. Reconnects if connected.

_vpn-regions.doc: List PIA regions (latency shown after an auto connect).

_vpn-selftest.doc: Check the PIA login works — prints OK/FAILED only, never the credentials or token.

_vpn-status.doc: Show VPN and kill switch state.

agent.doc: Open your AI assistant (Claude Code or OpenCode) in /etc/nixos

ai-account-add.doc: Sign in an extra Claude account

ai-account-mode.doc: Near a usage limit: warn only (manual) or also switch (auto)

ai-account-use.doc: Pick the Claude account for new sessions (a label, or 'next')

ai-crash-mute.doc: Mute, unmute or list crash notifications

ai-pick.doc: Choose your AI assistant (claude or opencode)

backup-now.doc: Run the restic backup now instead of waiting for the timer

backup-plex.doc: Archive Plex's data to a portable .tar.gz (for moving servers)

bootloader.doc: Migrate to the Limine bootloader (UEFI), then clean up (menu)

build.doc: Build a role/GPU target without activating it

cache.doc: Binary caches: Attic push/bootstrap, Harmonia status (menu)

default.doc: List all available recipes (default when running `just` with no arguments).

deploy.doc: Pull the latest vexos-nix config without moving nixpkgs

diagnose.doc: Have your AI assistant explain a problem (a unit name, or 'rebuild')

fix-flake.doc: Make an older /etc/nixos/flake.nix load features.nix (run once)

kernel.doc: Custom kernel builder: build now, status, follow the log (menu)

kill-switch.doc: VPN kill switch: block traffic outside the tunnel, or restore it (menu)

mergerfs-pool.doc: mergerfs + SnapRAID pool: create, add/remove disks, sync (menu)

nas-sync-status.doc: Show the schedule and last result of every nas-sync job

plex-pass.doc: Plex Pass hardware transcoding: enable or disable (menu)

prune-services.doc: leave the next update failing exactly as before.

rebuild.doc: Rebuild and switch using the current variant

remote-storage.doc: Attach, detach or list NFS/SMB shares from another host (menu)

reset-defaults.doc: Reset all GNOME settings to the VexOS defaults

restore-plex.doc: Restore a backup-plex archive over this Plex install

restore-service.doc: Restore one service's data from the restic backups

rollback.doc: Roll back to the previous generation and make it the boot default

rollforward.doc: Roll forward to the next generation and make it the boot default

secrets-init.doc: One-time sops-nix setup: create this host's age key

service.doc: Server services: list, catalog, status, enable, disable (menu)

set-hostname.doc: Change the hostname (applies now, persists across rebuilds)

setup-tailscale.doc: First-time Tailscale setup: operator rights, then connect

ssh.doc: Copy your SSH key to another machine (user@host)

switch.doc: Switch role, GPU, desktop or hypervisor — prompts for anything not given

update.doc: Update flake inputs and rebuild (stops before a long kernel compile)

update-all.doc: Update and rebuild with no cache check (may compile for hours)

upgrade-analysis.doc: Check whether this config is ready for a new NixOS release (read-only)

variant.doc: Show the active role and GPU variant (e.g. vexos-desktop-amd)

vpn.doc: PIA VPN: sign in, connect, choose region or protocol (menu)

zfs-pool.doc: ZFS pools: create, import, replace disks, scrub (menu)
